Subject: Personal Loan Application

Dear Loan Officer,

I am writing to apply for a personal loan. I am employed with an annual income of $115,000 and own a condominium with a monthly mortgage payment of $1,350.

Please let me know the loan options for which I may qualify, along with the applicable interest rates, repayment terms, required documentation, and next steps. I would be happy to provide proof of income, identification, housing information, and any other documents needed to evaluate my application.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Sincerely,  
Karen Rowe
